review:
One Coin is the strangest slot in Wazdan's Coins series. The whole thing plays on a single reel. It sounds limiting, but everything still revolves around Hold the Jackpot, with the series' usual build-up squeezed into one column.

The extra twist is the Mystery Multiplier, a Bonus symbol that can multiply your bonus round wins by up to 10x. The Grand Jackpot is 500x, and Chance Level helps you get into the bonus more easily. Medium volatility, 96.17% RTP. It picked up three industry award nominations, and it's worth a look just to see how different it feels from the bigger-grid Coins games. Play the One Coin demo free just to see how a one-reel game works.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
